title: Migration Waypoint
description: Extension beyond the base spec pack (not in 01-spec.md/07-stages.md). A dated checkpoint in the Consumer Migration Workstream, tying a set of legacy Interfaces' retirement to specific teams' consumer-migration readiness -- what the Retirement Register's per-interface status alone doesn't express: which team must have moved by when, and what that milestone actually blocks.

teams.description: Team names from intake.json.teams[] whose consumers must have migrated off the listed interfaces by target_date.

interfaces.description: Legacy Interfaces this waypoint gates. Cross-reference retirement.json for each one's actual status.

status.description: pending = target_date not yet reached and on track; at-risk = target_date approaching with interfaces still active; met = every listed interface reached zero-traffic or retired by target_date; missed = target_date passed with an interface still active. Never advance past 'pending' without supporting evidence, same discipline as retirement.json.

rationale.description: Why this milestone exists and what it blocks downstream (e.g. a Context's Stage 8 decommission, a compliance deadline).
